name: help
stdout:
golingua v0 preview
Usage: golingua --help | --version | capabilities --json | meaning canonicalize --json < meaning.json | meaning project --json < meaning.json | question --runtime-config <path> [--language pl|en] --json < question.json | translate --from <lang> --to <lang> --text <text> --json [--preview-id <id>] [--runtime-config <path>] | forms --language pl|en (--lexeme <id> --feature name=value... | --surface <form>) --json | catalog --summary|--details --json | snapshot --preview|--apply --store <path> --json
Algebra: golingua algebra check --input <file> [--metadata <package.json> ...] --json (or stdin with --input -); algebra build --metadata <package.json> [--metadata ...] [--input <construction.json>] --json (stdin if omitted or --input -); algebra synthesize --mode construct --metadata <package.json> [--metadata ...] --goal <goal.json> --json (stdin with --goal -); algebra synthesize --mode search --metadata <package.json> [--metadata ...] --goal <goal.json> [--search-limit name=value ...] --json (stdin with --goal -); algebra catalog export --json (compiled inert catalog inventory); algebra facts validate --metadata <package.json> [--metadata ...] [--input <facts.json>] --json (stdin if omitted or --input -); algebra export --metadata <package.json> [--metadata ...] [--input <request.json>] --json [--no-cache] (stdin if omitted or --input -); algebra inspect [--input <artifact.json>] --json (structural only, no metadata verification; stdin if omitted or --input -); algebra replay --metadata <package.json> [--metadata ...] [--input <request.json>] --json (stdin if omitted or --input -); algebra normalize --metadata <package.json> [--metadata ...] [--input <request.json>] --json (stdin if omitted or --input -); algebra verify-rewrite --metadata <package.json> [--metadata ...] [--input <verification.json>] --json (stdin if omitted or --input -); algebra metadata inspect|validate --metadata <package.json> [--metadata <package.json> ...] --json. Export and replay use explicitly selected metadata; replay checks artifact claims against independently supplied metadata and request context. Inspect checks structural integrity only. Normalize applies only the rewrite rules explicitly listed in a finite profile; verify-rewrite checks a submitted certificate against selected metadata. Neither command evaluates facts or synthesizes a proof. Synthesize constructs finite explicit representations with source constraint mapping; search returns scoped candidates and export requests without choosing one or proving world truth. Candidate retention bytes and the separate 16 MiB whole-response cap are distinct.  Metadata files are explicit inputs; validation is structural and does not prove world truth.
question executes typed MeaningGraph requests against caller-supplied FactSets; it does not parse natural language. With --language, supported answers use verified PL/EN sentence routes and retain proof evidence.
Compiled PL/EN sentence adapters cover limited seeing, hearing, looking, and reading (present 3sg/3pl and past 3sg/3pl), bounded present negation for seeing/hearing/looking in 3sg/3pl (EN do/does not; PL nie), and receiving (past 3sg/3pl); Polish plural past requires known subject number and agreement class. Reading supports English simple past read and Polish czytać past forms in third-person singular and plural; plural English read remains tense-ambiguous. Identification classifies a compatible known referent (for example, cat or dog) and attributes black to that referent in the tested PL/EN routes. English realization retains this/that/it alternatives for unresolved reference and this/that for demonstrative reference, with explicit reference assumptions; Polish to/ten may carry a declared deixis loss when source proximity is not preserved. A bounded positive composition route supports a present seeing event with a black subject and an object, both singular, including compatible known nouns. Other modifier combinations, tenses, numbers, and unsupported or missing lexical forms are refused. These routes do not resolve entity identity or animal sex. translate requires --runtime-config with an active snapshot.
